verification_policy: Keep schema-valid parent transformation records unique. Document every individual staged form without creating duplicate canonical records. Do not silently classify cast-only transformations as CaC Awoken skills.
schema_model: Canonical skill records use class=Awoken and subcategory=Race because the repository schema does not define a Transformation subcategory. The Transformations count is a derived category/index count, not a separate skill subcategory.
correction: The previous normalization implementation incorrectly attempted to create 20 Awoken/Transformation records and used unsupported research_status and subcategory values. The corrected implementation creates 15 schema-valid parent records and preserves the 20-form roster in research documentation.
